title: It worked, then it didn't
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: A trade can move your way and still end at the stop. The stop and the target are decided before entry, and they stay where they are.
intro.advanced: 09:50 ET. Read it. Note what the trade does after entry, and what you'd have to do differently.

whyNot.label: moving the stop to break even on the way
whyNot.why: Not part of this plan, and not what scores: the question is whether the entry, stop and target were right when they were set. Trade management is a separate skill this simulator doesn't grade.

reference.summary: A valid short: buy-side swept, displacement down, retrace into the gap, previous day low as the draw. The trade ran well past 1R, turned, and stopped out above the sweep high. A sound process, a -1R result.

bias.why: Lower highs and lower lows on the Daily and 4H; the overnight rally was a retrace.

decision.why: Everything required is present. Take it, or wait for the retrace to the gap.
